correctness.rationale: All period shifts are characterized by residue-class chains with two ones; the two possibilities give the exact singleton-marker tail or exact two-marker exceptional gap. The allowed i interval and reflection pairing count the exceptional signatures, account for the unique duplicate at p=n-1, and give a period-six evaluated sum. Singleton profiles follow from the central unpaired reflection position plus one even-length boundary. The standalone direct-shift checker verified all words at 2<=n<=100, 172650 total cases including larger randomized checks. Finite tests support but do not establish infinite claims.

value.rationale: Fixed-composition autocorrelation signatures are natural observations for reconstruction and periodicity. The theorem solves an infinite family with an exact structural classification, six-residue quadratic count and full unique-reconstruction criterion. The result reveals a sharp 1/6 asymptotic proportion of distinguishable signatures within the two-marker ensemble and shows unique fibers are sparse; this is more than direct small-table enumeration. It does not imply results at higher composition weights.
